newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans fall, March fast, on budget data.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans fall, March fast, on budget data.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures were sharply lower with the March contract in fast dealings in response to U.S. crop production figures included in President Bill Clinton's proposed budget, traders said.
The budget figures projected U.S. soybean acreage at 64 million acres with production at 2.4 billion bushels.
The figures were based on conditions as of November 1996, USDA officials told Reuters.
Those projections were slightly above the actual 1996-97 production figures released by USDA in January. In the January 10 report, USDA pegged U.S. soybean production at 2.382 billion bushels.
Soybeans ended down 10-1/2 to 4-1/2 cents per bushel with March off 10-1/2 at $7.29.
